content: {"episode_id":"ep-05086","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-97 denial for cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271), which was denied as bundled into another covered procedure. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, with diagnosis codes I25.10 and I34.0. Because the symptoms are intermittent, cardiac event monitoring was ordered to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances and evaluate for potential arrhythmias."}
